name: browser-use
headline: Droidz - AI Spec-Driven Development
short_description: Droidz is an AI automation skill that enables spec-driven development for software teams. It provides structured workflows and standards, reducing context loss and ad-hoc prompting. Operations teams can integrate Droidz with Claude to streamline development processes and improve software quality.
author: korallis

sections.overview:
Droidz is a framework that brings systematic structure to AI-assisted software development, eliminating ad-hoc prompting and context loss. It guides teams through an 8-phase workflow from product planning through specification, task creation, and implementation—with support for parallel execution of multiple task groups simultaneously. The framework includes 50+ production skills covering TDD, Next.js, security patterns, and more, enabling consistent code quality across features. Teams using Droidz establish shared standards that persist across sessions, improving developer onboarding and reducing rework from vague requirements. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, and Factory AI, it transforms how software teams collaborate with AI agents.
Implementing features consistently across multiple task groups in parallel
Establishing and enforcing team coding standards across AI-assisted development
Reducing context loss and rework by persisting specifications in version control
Accelerating feature development with guided, multi-phase workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/korallis/Droidz`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a spec-driven development plan for [PROJECT_NAME] using Droidz standards. Include: 1) A clear project scope with [REQUIREMENTS_LIST], 2) A modular architecture breakdown with [TECH_STACK] components, 3) Implementation milestones with [DEADLINES], 4) Testing strategy with [TEST_TYPES], and 5) Rollback/backup procedures. Ensure all outputs follow Droidz spec format and include traceability links between requirements and code artifacts.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
